title: Easy to put together, looks nice
text:
Easy to put together, looks nice. This rolling cart is great! It looks nice, a modern look. It was easy to put together.

It rolls smoothly.

product_metadata.title: Taylor + Logan Kitchen Server and Bar Cart with 3 Bottle Compartment, Light Oak Wood
features: Store bottles, dinnerware, serveware and bar accessories
description: This simple, yet intriguingly designed bar cart is perfect for storing and serving.This push style kitchen cart has raised bars for tip over prevention and a three compartment bottle holder. A chain frame and hooded casters give this mobile kitchen cart a boost in style and appearance.Serve guests, store tableware, or store beverages on this versatile bar cart.
